Kenya has reported its first-ever Ebola death, the health minister announced on Tuesday, as the disease continues to spread rapidly through the north-east of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where the outbreak was announced in May.
This is the 17th outbreak of the highly infectious, often deadly disease in the DRC. As of 2 October, 4,082 people had died out of 8,463 confirmed cases in the country since the emergence of the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus, for which there is still no vaccine nor specific treatment.

Inquest under way into why President Lula’s success in curbing Amazon deforestation has not led to success at polls 
More fire, more ash, more crime, more death. And a globally important ecosystem driven ever more rapidly towards a point of no return. That is the prospect for the Amazon rainforest for at least the next four years if Flávio Bolsonaro holds on to the lead he established this week in the first round of Brazil’s presidential election.

articles.title: Canada to indefinitely bar mental illness as sole reason for access to euthanasia
articles.description:
Legislation is an effort by ruling Liberals to address growing clash over who has access to doctor-assisted death
Canada’s federal government said on Wednesday it would advance legislation to prevent people whose sole health condition is mental illness from accessing euthanasia, an effort by the ruling Liberal party to address a clash in the country over who has access to physician-assisted death.
Under the current rules, people whose sole underlying medical condition is a mental illness have been barred from accessing medical assistance in dying (Maid) to end their lives. But that ban – due to be lifted in March – has divided lawmakers over whether to permit this expansion of the Maid program.
In Canada, Crisis Services Canada can be contacted at any time on 1.833.456.4566, or via text on 45645 from 4pm-12am ET. In the US, you can call or text the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline at 988 or chat at 988lifeline.org. In the UK and Ireland, Samaritans can be contacted on freephone 116 123. In Australia, the crisis support service Lifeline is 13 11 14. Other international helplines can be found at befrienders.org

articles.title: UK to make last-ditch effort to stop Israel closing East Jerusalem consulate

articles.title: Too young to run, old enough to protest: West Africa’s unfinished democratic bargain

articles.title: The sound of resistance

articles.summary: Global Voicesの「民主主義における抗議」特集の一環として、世界中のコミュニティから集められた過去および現在の抗議音楽の事例を紹介する共同記事。文化を通じた抵抗の形態を考察する。

articles.title: Who can speak on behalf of the people? The new frontiers of protest in the Sahel

articles.title: When telcos shut down the internet, they shut down protests for the government

articles.summary: アフリカでは政府が逮捕、夜間外出禁止令、インターネット遮断により異議申し立てを抑制。街頭での抗議が困難になるにつれ、不満はオンラインへと移行する傾向にある。

articles.title: What #EndSARS left behind in Nigeria: A generation caught between protest, politics, and departure

articles.titleJa: #EndSARSがナイジェリアに残したもの：抗議、政治、そして離脱に挟まれた世代

articles.title: The long journey from ‘Indigenous’ to citizen in Mozambique

articles.titleJa: モザンビークにおける「先住民」から市民への長い道のり

articles.summary: スイスで開催されたフォーラムで、ノードキストWTO事務次長補は、地政学と経済安全保障が貿易決定において重要性を増す中、WTOとその基本機能の重要性が高まっていると述べ、貿易の回復力を強調した。

articles.title: Director-General cites concerns with pace of negotiations as chairs report on state of play
articles.description: A meeting of the Trade Negotiations Committee (TNC) on 1 October provided WTO members with an opportunity to take stock of the WTO's negotiating agenda six months after the 14th Ministerial Conference (MC14) in Yaoundé and voice their views on how to advance their work. Members heard readouts from the chairs of the negotiating bodies about the state of play in their respective talks.

articles.title: Co-sponsors of Plastics Dialogue hold first round of technical discussions following MC14
articles.description: At a meeting on 1 October 2026, WTO members participating in the Dialogue on Plastics Pollution and Environmentally Sustainable Plastics Trade (DPP) held the first substantive round of discussions across four areas of work: circular solutions to plastics pollution; waste-management technologies; single-use plastics; and trade-related plastics measures. Building on the DPP's outcomes from the 14th Ministerial Conference (MC14) in March 2026 and earlier technical work, the discussions were aimed at moving towards more focused and practical work in the lead-up to MC15.
articles.titleJa: プラスチック対話共同提案国がMC14後の初の技術的議論を実施
articles.summary: 2026年10月1日、プラスチック汚染と持続可能なプラスチック貿易に関する対話(DPP)の参加国は、MC14の成果を踏まえ、循環的解決策、廃棄物管理、使い捨てプラスチック、貿易措置の4分野で初の技術的議論を行った。

articles.title: Members take stock of latest discussions on WTO reform
articles.description: At a transparency session on 30 September, facilitators for the discussions on WTO reform reported on recent meetings among members on the four tracks of reform: foundational issues, decision- making, development and level playing field. The facilitators noted a high level of engagement with members' written and oral proposals submitted in recent weeks. They acknowledged that momentum is building across all four tracks, but substantial work remains.
articles.titleJa: 加盟国がWTO改革に関する最新の議論を評価
articles.summary: 9月30日の透明性セッションで、WTO改革議論の促進者は、基盤問題、意思決定、開発、公平な競争条件の4つの分野における進捗を報告。多くの作業が残るものの、全分野で勢いが増していると述べた。

articles.title: John H. Jackson Moot Court Competition kicks off with webinar support on offer
articles.description: Prospective participants in the 25th edition of the John H. Jackson Moot Court Competition on WTO Law, launched on 16 September 2026, are invited to attend webinars aimed at helping them to effectively participate in the competition.
articles.titleJa: ジョン・H・ジャクソン・モートコート・コンペティションがウェビナー支援でキックオフ
articles.summary: 2026年9月16日に開始された第25回ジョン・H・ジャクソンWTO法モートコート・コンペティションの参加希望者向けに、効果的な参加を支援するためのウェビナーが開催されることが発表された。

articles.title: WTO members deepen discussions on trade and climate measures, share updates
articles.description: The Committee on Trade and Environment (CTE) met on 28-29 September to advance its discussions on the trade and environment nexus, focusing on interoperability and development aspects of trade-related climate measures. Members also built on the voluntary information sharing exercise launched earlier this year with a view to enhancing transparency of trade and climate measures in the Committee. In addition, they were briefed on work undertaken in other international fora and on developments in several member-led environmental initiatives at the WTO.
articles.titleJa: WTO加盟国が貿易と気候変動対策に関する議論を深め、最新情報を共有
articles.summary: 9月28-29日の貿易と環境委員会(CTE)で、WTO加盟国は貿易と気候変動対策の関連性、特にその相互運用性と開発側面について議論を深化。透明性向上のための情報共有も行われた。
